Harbour office Torvig

The harbour office administers the five inhabited islands of the Kestrel archipelago: Torvig, Little Kestrel, Skarn, Ovray and Bellhorn. Torvig Harbour has the only deep-water pier; the mail boat redistributes from there.

What you find here

  • The tide of the Ashwind Sea — range, rule of twelfths, the Ovray rule
  • The flag signal code — the six flags and how they are read

Contact

Harbour office, Torvig Harbour. In an emergency use channel 16, or the red flag from the signal mast if the radio is down.

Invented material for testing the lernkarten pipeline. No island here exists.
